# Rudy C Tarumingkeng's Academic Resource Site

> > The academic and research repository of Prof Rudy C Tarumingkeng, covering doctoral supervision, termitology, pest management, and quantitative ecology from Institut Pertanian Bogor.

This site documents the career and scholarly work of Prof Rudy C Tarumingkeng, a distinguished researcher at Institut Pertanian Bogor (IPB) specializing in entomology, forest pest management, and wood preservation. It serves as a resource for graduate students, researchers, and professionals interested in Indonesian agricultural science and mathematical ecology.

## Key Topics

- Prof Rudy C Tarumingkeng
- Institut Pertanian Bogor (IPB)
- Termitology
- Pest Management
- Population Dynamics
- Mathematical Modeling
- Doctoral Supervision
- Leslie Matrix
- Lotka-Volterra Models
- Wood Preservation
- Entomology
- Pesticide Classification
- Quantitative Ecology
- Forest Pests
- Insect Biology

## Academic Profile & Leadership

- [Rudyct's Vitae](http://www.rudyct.com/About_me.htm): Curriculum vitae and academic biography of Prof Rudy C Tarumingkeng
- [Penelitan](http://www.rudyct.com/karya-gurubesar-rudyct.htm): Prof Tarumingkeng's research in termitology, forest pests, and wood preservation
- [Bimbingan Doktor oleh Prof Rudy C Tarumingkeng, PhD](http://www.rudyct.com/rudyct-bimbingan-s3.htm): Doctoral supervision and dissertation guidance by Prof Rudy C Tarumingkeng

## Quantitative Ecology & Mathematical Modeling

- [Leslie6](http://www.rudyct.com/MCADfiles/Leslie6.htm): Leslie matrix modeling for age-structured population dynamics in Mathcad
- [Simulations of Equilibrium, Steady state and Chaotic behavior](http://www.rudyct.com/STABILITAS.htm): Quantitative ecology simulations: equilibrium, stability, and chaos in populations
- [LVEU6](http://www.rudyct.com/MCADfiles/LVEU6.htm): Lotka-Volterra predator-prey model simulation and mathematical modeling tutorial
- [lifetab6](http://www.rudyct.com/MCADfiles/lifetab6.htm): Lifetable analysis and population dynamics tutorial using Mathcad
- [KESTABILAN KUALITATIF, MULTISPESIES](http://www.rudyct.com/MCADfiles/HARUNI.htm): Qualitative stability analysis for multispecies ecological systems

## Entomology & Pest Management

- [Biologi dan perilaku rayap](http://www.rudyct.com/biologi_dan_perilaku_rayap.htm): Termite biology, behavior, colonies, and damage patterns in Indonesian
- [Serangga dan lingkungan](http://www.rudyct.com/SERANGGA_LINGK.htm): Insect biology and ecology: impacts on environment and human life
- [Rev](http://www.rudyct.com/TOX/PESTISIDA.htm): Pesticide classification, types, and insecticide safety guide

## Graduate Student Publications

- [My Graduate Student (S3) papers (IPB) – 2000-2007](http://www.rudyct.com/PPS702-ipb/makalah-pps702.htm): Archive of graduate student papers from IPB course PPS702 (2000-2007)

- [PERAN STRATEGIS PENGEMBANGAN SUMBER DAYA MANUSIA](http://www.rudyct.com/STRAT_PSDM.htm): Strategic human resource management and organizational development lecture
